text: This report recommends the award of a contract for consulting services for the Outdoor Orangutan Exhibit, RFP 58 (2018-10).

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Recommended that the contract for architectural, engineering and project management services for Request for Proposal (RFP) 58 (2018-10) Consulting Services - Outdoor Orangutan Exhibit be awarded to Zeidler Partnership Architects in the amount of $350,075.00, excluding HST.
